status.en: 20 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 33% more than the week before, most of them in Kivu, Kinshasa and Ituri.
status.nb: 20 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 33 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Kivu, Kinshasa og Ituri.

summary.en: M23 rebels have withdrawn from the Bunia area but opened a new front near the Uganda border, pushing toward Uvira city. Ugandan forces are pulling out of a DR Congo town amid a diplomatic dispute, while Muhoozi Kainerugaba’s social media posts have angered the Congolese government. In Ituri, fighting forced WHO to evacuate its Ebola response team from a hospital, with the outbreak now exceeding 12,000 cases and a death rate near 50 percent. M23 fighters claim to have shot down a Congolese military aircraft that is now missing, and a South African mercenary pilot was captured. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
